title: Six Minutes to Platform Nine
story: The departure board changed while Nadia was buying water, and her train moved from platform four to platform nine. She had six minutes and a heavy suitcase, so she asked a member of staff which stairs were closest. He pointed to a lift at the far end and said it would be quicker than the crowded steps. She reached the doors just as they opened.

vocabulary.definition: The moment when a train leaves.
The area in a station where people get on a train.
A large bag with a handle, used for travel.
Full of people, with little room to move.
A machine that carries people from one floor to another.

quiz.question: Which platform did Nadia’s train move to?
options: Platform nine
Platform four
The station shop
The crowded steps
quiz.explanation: The board showed that her train had moved from platform four to platform nine.
quiz.supportingSentence: The departure board changed while Nadia was buying water, and her train moved from platform four to platform nine.

quiz.question: Why did the nearest route matter so much to Nadia?
options: She had very little time and a heavy bag
She had already missed the train
She wanted to buy a second bottle
She worked for the station
quiz.correctAnswer: She had very little time and a heavy bag
quiz.explanation: With six minutes and a heavy suitcase, she needed the closest way to the train.
quiz.supportingSentence: She had six minutes and a heavy suitcase, so she asked a member of staff which stairs were closest.

quiz.question: How much time did Nadia have when she reached the train?
options: Almost none, because the doors were just opening
A full hour on the old platform
None, because the train had already left
Enough to go back and buy more water
quiz.correctAnswer: Almost none, because the doors were just opening
quiz.explanation: She reached the doors just as they opened, so she had almost no time to spare.
quiz.supportingSentence: She reached the doors just as they opened.

quiz.question: What does crowded mean in this story?
options: Full of people
Quicker than a lift
Closed for repairs
Far from the train
quiz.explanation: The steps are called crowded, and the lift is offered as a quicker choice.
quiz.supportingSentence: He pointed to a lift at the far end and said it would be quicker than the crowded steps.

quiz.question: Why did Nadia ask which stairs were closest?
options: She needed the fastest way to the new platform
She wanted someone to carry her water
She hoped to move the train back
She was looking for a place to sit
quiz.correctAnswer: She needed the fastest way to the new platform
quiz.explanation: She asked which stairs were closest because she had only six minutes to reach the train.
quiz.supportingSentence: She had six minutes and a heavy suitcase, so she asked a member of staff which stairs were closest.
